method: Eight disposable source copies. Original tests retained. Detection requires intended observable assertion, not harness crash.

results.name: tooltip-title
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 tooltip titles are idempotent on idle, focus and unrelated settings
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: |-
    unchanged tooltip title writes
    + actual - expected
    
    + [
    +   'Angular Speed: 1.5707963267948966 rad/s (90.0°/s)',
    +   'Angular Speed: 1.5707963267948966 rad/s (90.0°/s)'
    + ]
    - []
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected:
  actual:
    0: 'Angular Speed: 1.5707963267948966 rad/s (90.0°/s)'
    1: 'Angular Speed: 1.5707963267948966 rad/s (90.0°/s)'
  operator: 'deepStrictEqual'

results.name: duplicate-recorder
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 recorder projects once on change and never duplicates unchanged projection
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: |-
    unchanged recorder must not project
    
    30 !== 0
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: 0
  actual: 30
  operator: 'strictEqual'

results.name: selector-aria
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 idle source selectors, transport and launchers perform no redundant writes
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: 'unchanged selectors/launcher ARIA writes'
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: true
  actual: false
  operator: '=='

results.name: source-error-stale
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 source errors and permission status propagate without settings replacement
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: |-
    The input did not match the regular expression /Microphone permission denied/. Input:
    
    'Waiting for microphone permission.'
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected:
  actual: 'Waiting for microphone permission.'
  operator: 'match'

results.name: finalization-stale
results.expectedEvidence: finalization busy accessibility must update promptly
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 recorder finalization alone updates busy/status and completion unlocks transport
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: |-
    finalization busy accessibility must update promptly
    
    'false' !== 'true'
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: 'true'
  actual: 'false'
  operator: 'strictEqual'

results.name: hidden-reveal-stale
results.expectedEvidence: reveal must refresh canonical values synchronously
failures: not ok 1 - AUD-004 hidden Visualizers reveal refreshes values, titles and focus before a frame
results.assertionExcerpt:
error: |-
    reveal must refresh canonical values synchronously
    + actual - expected
    
    + '1.5707963267948966'
    - '0.234567'
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: '0.234567'
  actual: '1.5707963267948966'
  operator: 'strictEqual'
